spec.variant: Shot 2: the A2 portrait with the wordmark (R4: whole instrument, T1)
spec.narrative: Cut out to the portrait: the complete instrument at A2's three-quarter, the ANDOR wordmark standing in the dark behind it, the far corner crossing the foot of the letters. The camera eases back by 1.5 % and settles; the instrument and the type stay registered.
spec.notes: R4: A2's direction at 1.10x its distance (the whole instrument in frame, with room at the front-right corner); 1.5 % settle as in R3; T1 only.
